openings.claim: Contact-gate insertion stop A and clamp B: seat before tightening, rather than tighten independently. This might prevent tighter-fit return error without altering rods. Proposed construction: two adjustable plywood saddles, fixed end stops, hand-tightened M5 restraint, and cord/elastic retention of every loosened component.
openings.discriminator: Rival: ordinary additive stop-plus-restraint benefit. Intact A×B predicts lower pointer displacement than identical parents tightened before stop contact. For lateral displacement d, test 7−dAB > (7−dA)+(7−dB); breaking the seating-to-tightening interface should remove that excess. Comparisons propose synergy, do not measure it; exchange repeatability could disagree.
openings.probe: Baseline: supplied 7 mm loose-joint displacement. Configuration one: allocate four load trials across A alone with restraint released, B alone with stop bypassed, and intact A×B. Configuration two: retain every parent component, break only the seating-to-tightening interface; allocate four load trials. Each configuration: twelve exchanges, five per original rod then two substituting 18 mm for 19 mm. Log return error, ten-second 10 N displacement, exchange time, initial setup and readjustment burden. Parent-only modes screen load, not full exchange validity.
openings.uncertainty: Unverified: six plywood pieces/hardware form retained saddles within 90 mm; square-end reproducibility across sizes. Preserve no drilling/adhesive/permanent rod marks, hand assembly/adjustment, no falling components. Defeat: no beyond-additive interaction, broken interface performs equally, any return >2 mm, load escape, exchange ≥40 seconds, or fabrication/testing exceeds 100/20 minutes. If released modes count as extra configurations, the two-configuration cap is exceeded: cannot proceed as specified. Screening plus exchanges within twenty minutes remains unknown; a stop cap alone establishes no informative feasible test.

lineage.reason: Retains coupling, construction, rival, interaction/breakage comparisons, probe limitations, declared uncertain fit and defeat/resource caveats.

decision: Fabrication review only. Deployment and target performance remain unestablished; resolve geometry, retention, mode counting and test capacity before proceeding.
